Our new developments

173 developments tracked · 59 cities10 years of experience in Israeli real estate development

The developer’s price. No extra cost. Zero agency fees. You buy directly at the developer’s price, with no middleman and no added commission. We guide you through every step, and you get our expertise at no extra cost.
Prices are negotiable. We negotiate for you. Discount, floor, orientation, kitchen, payment schedule… Every detail counts. We negotiate directly with the developer, in Hebrew, to get you the best possible terms and protect your interests at every step.
The real cost, with no unpleasant surprises. Purchase tax, attorney fees, the developer’s payment schedule, mortgage payments… From our first meeting, you have a clear picture of the total cost of your purchase. You move forward knowing every number, well before you sign.
Hillel Bijaoui

Ten years in Israeli real estate, most of them with developers, on the seller's side. I know how a price is built, what is truly negotiable, and what is never negotiable.

Today that knowledge works for you, and you pay no agency fee: I am paid by the developer, and you sign at the price negotiated before you ever arrive.

We follow 173 projects in 59 cities. You are not buying a floor plan on a screen: someone goes to the construction site, speaks Hebrew at the sales office, and stays with you until the keys are handed over, including the lawyer and the bank.

The first call costs nothing and does not commit you to anything.
